title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents

paragraphs.en: Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能生成的研究中，某些缺陷可以通过其人工产物识别出来；而另一些缺陷则需要了解执行前已批准的内容。 我们提出研究合同，将声明的实验选择、运行义务和主张范围与记录的执行证据绑定，并将这种基于合同的验证与科学真理区分开来。 一项使用八个由作者自行编写的干净/变异对进行的诊断，展示了信息边界。 一个确定性检查器应用了针对已批准且已执行对象的注册故障特定规则，检测到了全部八个已注册的变异。 在十八个记录在案的法官别名中，每个别名都获得了经过元数据过滤的独立包（无配对上下文或注册表选定的故障标签），其中144个变异评估案例中有104个收到了缺陷标记；其余案例包括32个弃权案例和8个终端失败案例，且对变异案例未作出明确的干净判定。 某些包保留了批准和执行字段，包括摘要信息。 提示要求法官在证据不足时选择弃权。 这些结果描述了一个刻意设计为信息不对称的开发环境；它们并未将权威信息的影响与任务规格和规则选择的差异区分开来，也不涉及验证器质量或智能体奖励机制的操纵比较。 我们认为，全信息比较、合法适应控制以及闭环智能体评估是必要的测试，用以判断合同检查是否能在优化条件下提升有用且合规的完成度。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: agent verification; research agents; environment grounding; information asymmetry; proxy gaming; claim admissibility; human-authenticated gates

paragraphs.en: A meta-agent development loop needs a mutation operator over the agent (prompt, tool, plan, scaffold, memory policy), an evaluation environment and a decision rule. For coding agents the environment is a repository and the reward is a test suite. For research agents the intended reward is “the science got better”, and there is nothing to call.
paragraphs.zh: 元智能体开发循环需要一个针对智能体（提示、工具、计划、框架、记忆策略）的变异算子、一个评估环境以及一条决策规则。 对于编码智能体，其环境是一个代码库，而奖励则是一套测试用例。 对于研究智能体，预期的奖励是“科学得到了进步”，而且没有任何可调用之物。

paragraphs.en: What developers use instead falls into four families. Task completion can be satisfied without validity: a study with a broken comparator completes on schedule. We do not claim the two are statistically independent, or nearly so; we have measured no association between completion and validity, and the point needed here is only the one-directional one that completion does not entail validity. Artifact presence is improved considerably by evidence-bound task verification, which requires artifacts before a completion claim is accepted [ 1 ] ; it remains a task-level check, and a task can be complete while a study-level superiority, transfer or fairness claim is unsupported. Unit and integration tests verify software correctness; a correctly implemented metric computed on the wrong split is a passing test and an invalid result. LLM-as-judge on the output reads the write-up, which is the surface the agent controls most directly and most cheaply; contemporary AI-scientist systems already produce fluent manuscripts end to end [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 开发者转而使用的工具可分为四大类。 任务完成无需具备有效性：一项使用故障比较器的研究仍能按时完成任务。 我们并未声称这两者在统计上相互独立，甚至接近独立；我们尚未测得任务完成与有效性之间存在任何关联，此处需要强调的仅是一个单向结论：任务完成并不必然意味着有效性。 通过基于证据的任务验证可以显著提升人工产物的存在性，这种验证要求在接受任务完成的声明前必须确认人工产物的存在 [ 1 ]；但它仍然属于任务层面的检查，一项任务可能已经完成，而研究层面的优越性、迁移性或公平性主张却缺乏支持。 单元测试和集成测试用于验证软件的正确性；一个正确实现但基于错误数据分割计算的指标，会表现为通过测试却得出无效结果的情况。 LLM 作为对输出的评判者会阅读撰写说明，这是智能体能够最直接、最低成本控制的表层内容；当前的 AI 科学家系统已经能够端到端地生成流畅的完整文稿 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ]。

paragraphs.en: The common structural limitation is not that every proxy is agent-authored—tests and task criteria may be externally fixed—but that these signals are task- or output-local. They need not encode the relation between the authorized study and what was executed, so some of them can move without study identity being preserved. Whether an optimizing agent does exploit that gap is an empirical question that this paper does not answer; the reward-hacking and specification-gaming literature explains why it is a hypothesis worth testing [ 5 , 6 ] . What we can show is narrower: which registered faults were frequently inferred from the metadata-filtered package under this asymmetric design, and which were rarely flagged.
paragraphs.zh: 常见的结构性限制并非每个代理都由智能体亲自创建——测试和任务标准可能由外部固定设定——而在于这些信号仅限于特定任务或输出。 它们无需编码授权研究与实际执行内容之间的关系，因此其中一些可以在不保留研究身份的情况下被转移。 一个优化型智能体是否确实利用了这一差距，是一个经验性问题，本文并未回答；奖励破解与规范博弈的相关文献解释了为何这是一个值得检验的假设 [5, 6]。 我们能够证明的内容更为有限：在这种非对称设计下，哪些已登记的故障能通过元数据过滤后的包被频繁推断出来，而哪些则很少被标记。

paragraphs.en: We address research agents operating on computational science: code, seeds, jobs, schedulers, metrics, artifacts. We make no clinical, diagnostic or safety-certification claim. The verification signal described here concerns contract-relative methodological eligibility; it says nothing about whether a result is true.

paragraphs.en: The trust boundary is stated once so that every later claim can be read against it. Protected: the approved contract revision and its digest chain, the gold labels of the development corpus, the authorization record, and the checker’s own predicate. Assumed: execution observations are collected through a path the agent cannot rewrite; if that assumption fails, record integrity does not imply truthful observation. Untrusted: the agent’s transcript, its narrative, its proposed specification edits and its self-reported completion. Checked actions: the named approval, waiver, data-governance and promotion transitions on tested entry points; the historical refusal audit covered 11 of 14 cells with three MCP cells not_reached , so “cannot bypass” is a statement about the checked boundaries, not a universal property. If an agent can edit the approved contract, the gold labels, the observations or the authorization record, the relation can be gamed. “Cannot improve the score with its narrative” is at most true of the particular protected deterministic predicate; it is not true of scientific validity, of author-written contract scope, or of the whole system.
paragraphs.zh: 信任边界仅陈述一次，以便后续所有主张都能据此进行验证。 受保护内容：经批准的合同修订版本及其摘要链、开发语料库的黄金标签、授权记录以及检查器自身的谓词。 假设条件：执行观察通过智能体无法篡改的路径收集；若该假设不成立，则记录完整性并不保证观察结果的真实性。 不可信内容：智能体的转录记录、其叙述、其提议的规范修改以及其自我报告的完成情况。 已检查操作：在受测试入口点处执行的具体批准、豁免、数据治理和升级转换；历史拒绝审计覆盖了14个单元格中的11个，其中3个MCP单元格未被触及，因此“无法绕过”这一说法仅针对已检查的边界，而非普遍成立的特性。 如果智能体能够修改经批准的合同、黄金标签、观察结果或授权记录，那么这种关系就可能被操纵。“无法通过其叙述提高得分”这一说法最多仅适用于特定的受保护确定性谓词；它并不适用于科学有效性、作者撰写的合同范围或整个系统。

paragraphs.en: Meta-science has long documented HARKing, undisclosed analytic flexibility, outcome switching, selective reporting and survivorship bias [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . We claim no novelty for the pathologies. The agent-development claim is narrower: an improvement loop scored on output proxies leaves these pathologies reachable through ordinary, non-adversarial agent behaviour, and output-only review may not detect them. Whether such a loop actually drifts toward them has not been tested here. We name six channels, framed as things a self-improving research agent could do that would raise or preserve proxy scores.
paragraphs.zh: 元科学早已记录了 HARKing（事后合理化）、未披露的分析灵活性、结果切换、选择性报告以及幸存者偏差 [7, 8, 9, 10]。 我们并不声称这些病理现象具有创新性。 智能体开发的主张更为有限：一个以输出代理指标为评分标准的改进循环，可能通过普通且非对抗性的智能体行为导致这些病理现象出现，而仅审查输出结果可能无法检测出它们。 这样的循环是否真的会向这些病理现象偏移，目前尚未在此得到验证。 我们指出了六个渠道，并将其框架化为一个自我改进的研究智能体可能采取的行为，这些行为会提升或维持代理指标的得分。

paragraphs.en: Edits that are usually engineering (paths, worker counts, device placement) travel through the same channel as edits that are usually scientific (arms, metrics, decision rules), and the two are indistinguishable unless the scientific identity of the study is a typed object. The partition is not fixed by the field’s name: batch size is not intrinsically harmless, because it can change optimization dynamics, normalization statistics and the effective learning-rate schedule, so whether a given batch-size edit is inside the approved study is a declared property of the contract rather than a property of the parameter. That is why the typed object, and not a hand-maintained list of “safe” fields, is what does the work.
paragraphs.zh: 通常属于工程性质的编辑（路径、工人数量、设备部署）与通常属于科学性质的编辑（分支、指标、决策规则）通过同一通道进行，除非研究的科学身份是一个带类型对象，否则两者无法区分。 这种划分并非由字段名称决定：批量大小本身并非无害，因为它可能改变优化动态、归一化统计量以及实际的学习率调度方案，因此某个特定的批量大小编辑是否属于受批准的研究范围，是合同中的一个声明属性，而非参数本身的属性。 正因如此，真正发挥作用的是带类型对象，而不是一个手动维护的“安全”字段列表。

paragraphs.en: Failed, timed-out, cancelled or never-started units disappear from denominators, and convenient retries re-enter as fresh successes. A retry loop is not itself the fault: retries bias the estimate only when the accounting omits attempts, so that a retried unit is counted once as a success rather than as one expected unit carrying several attempts. Where attempts are recorded against a locked denominator, repeated retries are visible and the denominator does not move; where they are not, the default reporting path silently selects on survival. Detectability from the output alone splits in two, and § 4.2 measures both halves: where the surviving package still carries the contradiction—unequal arm budgets, an artifact digest mismatch—16–18 of 18 output-only aliases flagged it, so this channel is not uniformly invisible; where the only trace is an absence (a required metric artifact that was never emitted), 1 of 18 flagged it.
paragraphs.zh: 失败、超时、取消或未启动的智能体会从分母中消失，而便捷的重试则会以新的成功状态重新进入。 重试循环本身并非问题所在：只有当统计方法忽略了尝试次数时，重试才会对估计值产生偏差，因此一个经过重试的智能体会被计为一次成功，而不是一个本应包含多次尝试的智能体。 如果尝试次数被记录在锁定的分母中，重复的重试会被清晰看到，且分母不会改变；反之，默认的报告机制会悄无声息地仅根据是否成功进行筛选。 仅从输出结果判断问题的能力分为两种情况，第 4.2 节对这两种情况进行了测量：当保留下来的包仍然包含矛盾之处——即臂预算不相等或存在人工产物摘要的不匹配——18 个仅依赖输出的别名中有 16–18 个检测到了这一问题，因此该渠道并非完全不可见；而当唯一痕迹是某种缺失（即某个必需的指标产物从未被发出）时，18 个别名中仅有 1 个检测到了它。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark result becomes a population, transfer, fairness or clinical claim. The artifact set contains no evidence for the inflated claim, which is not the same as containing nothing that contradicts it: an external-generalization claim sitting beside internal-only evidence is a visible mismatch, and § 4.2 records that 17 of 18 output-only aliases flagged exactly that case. M5 is therefore a channel that survives an inattentive reader rather than one that is unreadable from the package. What the contract adds here is not detection but the authorized ceiling against which scope is adjudicated, and the authority to block promotion.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的结果会转化为关于群体、迁移、公平性或临床应用的论断。 该人工产物集合中没有任何证据支持这一夸大的论断，但这并不等同于其中不存在任何与之矛盾的内容：一个仅基于内部证据的外部泛化论断显然存在明显的不匹配，而 §4.2 记录了 18 个仅输出型别名中有 17 个明确指出了这种情况。 因此，M5 是一个能够逃过粗心读者注意的渠道，而不是一个从包装上就无法阅读的内容。 合同在此处补充的并非检测机制，而是用于裁定作用范围的授权上限，以及阻止其推广的权力。

paragraphs.en: The package cannot be re-derived without private chat or memory state. This does not make every M1–M5 check impossible: the checks that read a contradiction already inside the package—an artifact digest disagreeing with its recorded value, unequal arm budgets, a generalization claim beside internal-only evidence—remain available without any re-derivation. What is lost is the ability to re-run the study to test facts the package does not contain, which is exactly what the absence-based faults require. An incomplete reconstruction manifest is itself visible in the package, and § 4.2 records 16–18 of 18 aliases flagging that case; the channel’s cost is the lost ability to re-check, not the concealment of the manifest.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有私人对话或记忆状态，该包无法重新推导。 这并不意味着所有 M1–M5 检查都无法进行：那些读取包内已有矛盾的检查——例如人工制品摘要与其记录值不符、臂预算不均衡、内部证据旁附有的泛化声明等——无需任何重新推导即可继续执行。 所失去的是重新运行研究以检验包中未包含事实的能力，而这正是基于缺失的故障所要求的。 不完整的重建清单本身在包中可见，且 § 4.2 记录了 18 个别名中的 16–18 个标记了这种情况；该通道的代价是失去重新检查的能力，而非清单被隐藏。

None of M1–M6 requires deception. Some systems already mitigate parts of this—AutoSci records lifecycle states, retains failed or abandoned attempts and supports recovery without chat history [ 4 ] —but those protections do not by themselves supply externally authorized scope, claim-bound evidence obligations or gated claim promotion.

paragraphs.en: Approval records a digest over the specification together with the compiler and capability identities used for locked compilation; post-approval mutation of any bound identity invalidates the approval. Digests bind representations : the approved specification and the compiled executable configuration are different objects, so “digest-identical to the authorized study” is the wrong phrase. The checkable object is a versioned chain—approved specification → \rightarrow compiler version → \rightarrow emitted run contracts → \rightarrow collected observations—in which hashes establish equality and tamper evidence at each link. Semantic preservation across the compiler, and honest observation at the last link, require separate assumptions or tests.
paragraphs.zh: 批准记录会汇总规范说明，以及用于锁定编译的编译器和能力标识；任何绑定标识在批准后的变更都会使该批准失效。 摘要会绑定各种表示：已批准的规范说明与编译后的可执行配置是两个不同的对象，因此“摘要与授权研究完全一致”这一表述是错误的。 可检查的对象是一个带版本标识的链式结构——已批准的规范说明 → 编译器版本 → 生成的运行合约 → 收集到的观察结果——其中哈希值可在每个环节确立一致性并提供篡改证据。 确保编译器全程保持语义不变，以及在最后环节获得诚实的观察结果，需要分别进行假设或测试。

paragraphs.en: Candidate claims carry typed scope over population, task and endpoint, data version and split, comparator, metric, time, site and domain. Obligations carry two independent fields: discharge_method ( mechanical or human_semantic ) and waiver_policy ( forbidden , scope_reducing , permitted_under_conditions ); a mechanical obligation may be non-waivable. paragraphs.en: The objection is that this ossifies the closed-loop adaptivity that makes research agents useful. It does not, if the frozen object is Π \Pi rather than the realized trajectory: Π \Pi declares which state-dependent decisions are in bounds, which search spaces and stopping rules apply, how expected-run accounting may undergo authorized expansion or contraction under prospectively specified rules, and which departures require reauthorization. Leaving the envelope is an explicit amendment or exploratory fork with a downgraded claim status. Implementation status: a synchronous attempt-admission-and-retry subset of Π \Pi is live on opt-in governed sweeps and was exercised in one fixture-approved integration trace; general adaptive enforcement (early stopping, asynchronous observation, multi-backend) and compiler-wired revision transitions are specified, not implemented. Promotion is a separate transition with prototype state and tests, not yet an ordinary-path blocking guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 反对意见是，这种做法固化了使研究智能体具有实用价值的闭环适应性。 如果被冻结的对象是 Π \Pi 而非实际实现的轨迹，情况则并非如此：Π \Pi 声明了哪些状态相关的决策在允许范围内、哪些搜索空间和停止规则适用、预期运行核算如何在未来指定的规则下经过授权扩展或收缩，以及哪些偏离需要重新授权。 超出该范围属于明确的修订或探索性分支，其主张地位会被降级。 实施状态：Π \Pi 的一个同步尝试-接纳-重试子集正在通过自愿参与的受控扫描运行，并已在一次经过测试批准的集成轨迹中得到应用；而通用的自适应执行机制（提前停止、异步观察、多后端支持）以及编译器内联的修订转换则仅被定义，尚未实施。 升级是一个独立的转换过程，包含原型状态和测试环节，目前尚未成为常规路径上的阻断性保障。

paragraphs.en: We used the self-authored development corpus: eight clean/mutated study-package pairs (seed 20260815), each mutation a registered methodological fault (Appendix C ). The deterministic contract checker received the approved study object and the executed package. Eighteen recorded provider aliases (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic; unpinned, evaluation window approximately 2026-08-15 UTC) each received one metadata-filtered package per case—without pair context or the registry-selected fault label—and were instructed by a frozen prompt (Appendix B ) to return mutation_detected , clean or abstain , and to abstain when the package did not contain enough information. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests in compilation-drift cases; the packages were therefore not emptied of all approval metadata. The deterministic checker applied the registered fault-specific rule for the mutation under test. This is deliberately information-asymmetric and task-asymmetric : the observed pattern is consistent with missing requirements mattering for some faults, but the design does not isolate the causal contribution of withheld requirements from differences in task specification and rule selection. One evaluation case per package, 16 cases per alias, 288 logical judgments; attempts are accounted separately, at 309 attempt entries and 303 adapter-log records, and the six-record difference between those two logs is reconciled per alias against the retained export. 288 therefore counts judgments rather than provider requests, neither 303 nor 309 is substituted for a judgment result, and no cost is reconciled from any of them.

paragraphs.en: Detection was strongly fault-dependent (Appendix C ): faults visible as contradictions inside the package—digest drift, mismatched budgets, overbroad external claims, incomplete reconstruction manifests, material workload mutation, artifact digest mismatch—were flagged by 16–18 of 18 aliases; the two absence faults, a missing split/grouping declaration and a missing required metric artifact, were flagged by 2/18 and 1/18. Those absence faults are the ones for which an approved requirement would specify what should have been present; the metadata-filtered judge was not given the registry-selected fault label or an equal-information task. Seventeen of eighteen aliases flagged the external-generalization case, so the corpus does not show that scientific degradation is concealed by a nicer manuscript; it shows a pattern consistent with missing requirements mattering for some faults, without experimentally isolating that causal contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 检测对故障的依赖性极强（附录 C）：在软件包内部表现为矛盾的各种故障——摘要漂移、预算不匹配、外部声明过于宽泛、重建清单不完整、材料工作负载突变以及产物摘要不匹配——均被 18 个别名中的 16–18 个标记出来；而两种缺失故障，即缺少拆分/分组声明和缺少必需的指标产物，则分别仅被 2/18 和 1/18 的别名标记。 这些缺失故障是指已批准的规范本应明确说明其必须存在的情况；但经过元数据过滤的判断器并未获得注册表选定的故障标签或同等信息量的任务。 在 18 个别名中，有 17 个标记了外部泛化案例，因此该语料库并未表明科学性的退化被更精美的手稿所掩盖；它展示的模式与某些故障中缺失规范的重要性相符，但并未通过实验明确分离出这一因果贡献。

paragraphs.en: As a constructed sanity check only, a deterministic surface heuristic that rewards package length, inflation vocabulary and thinner seed lists (no mutation labels) scored the mutated package above its clean control on 2/8 pairs and tied on 3/8 (5/8 at-least-as-high). It was designed to reward those features and is not a live model ranking; it demonstrates nothing about any optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 仅作为一个构造性的合理性检验，一种奖励包长度、膨胀词汇表和更精简的种子列表（无突变标签）的确定性表面启发式方法，在 2/8 个配对中使突变后的包得分高于其干净对照组，在 3/8 个配对中得分相同（至少 5/8 个配对得分不低于）。 该方法是专门设计来奖励这些特征的，并非一个实时模型排名；它无法说明任何优化器的特性。

paragraphs.en: It does not isolate verifier quality (the two instruments had different information and different task specifications), does not compare agents, does not estimate calibrated reviewer quality (fixtures and labels are self-authored; no held-out calibration), does not demonstrate reward hacking, and does not test whether a stronger output-only model could do better with the same package. What it reports is which registered faults remained frequently inferable from the metadata-filtered package and which were rarely flagged under this asymmetric design. That pattern is consistent with missing requirements, but the diagnostic does not experimentally establish which faults depended on the withheld study contract. A future equal-information comparison is required to attribute any advantage to deterministic checking rather than to access to authoritative requirements or to fault-specific rule selection.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究并未孤立地验证验证者的质量（两种工具的信息不同，任务规范也不同），未对智能体进行比较，未评估校准审核员的质量（固定内容和标签均由作者自行撰写；没有预留的校准数据），也未展示奖励破解现象，更没有测试一个更强、仅输出结果的模型在相同数据包中是否能表现更好。 其报告的内容是：哪些已登记的故障仍能从经过元数据过滤的数据包中被频繁推断出来，以及在此非对称设计下哪些故障很少被标记出来。 这一模式与需求缺失的情况一致，但该诊断并未通过实验确定哪些故障依赖于被保留的研究合同。 未来需要进行信息量相等的比较，才能将任何优势归因于确定性检查，而非对权威需求的访问权限或针对特定故障的规则选择。

Measure explicit false acceptance, false rejection, abstention, operational failure, cost and decision coverage separately.

paragraphs.en: The open question is whether admissibility remains useful under optimization: an agent scored on admissible-claim yield can propose narrow, trivially satisfiable studies. Hold a nontrivial task and claim requirement fixed, fix resources, retain every attempted action and failure, measure scientific utility independently of the contract pass flag, and record narrowing or abandonment; a high fraction of admitted trivial claims is not success. This is where enforcement during execution versus final-only checking can be compared on useful compliant completion . It overlaps with related execution-enforcement work and should not be published twice as independent evidence. This paper’s contribution is the threat model together with the information-boundary diagnostic actually reported in § 4.2 , which was run under deliberately asymmetric information. The equal-information ablation described above is proposed and has not been run ; no result in this paper comes from it, and until it is run no advantage of deterministic checking can be attributed to the checking rather than to its access to the approved requirements or to its fault-specific rule.
paragraphs.zh: 一个悬而未决的问题是，在优化过程中可接受性是否仍然有用：一个基于可接受主张产出获得评分的智能体，可能会提出范围狭窄且极易满足的研究方案。 保持一个非平凡的任务和主张要求不变，固定资源，记录所有尝试过的行动与失败，独立于合同通过标志来衡量科学效用，并记录研究范围的缩小或放弃；被接受的主张中若存在大量平凡主张，则不能算作成功。 正是在这一点上，可以在执行过程中的强制执行与仅最终检查之间，就其能否实现有效且合规的完成进行比较。 这与相关的执行-强制执行工作存在重叠，不应作为独立证据重复发表。 本文的贡献在于提出了威胁模型，以及第 4.2 节中实际报告的信息边界诊断方法，该诊断是在刻意设置的非对称信息条件下运行的。 上述描述的等信息消融分析已被提出但尚未运行；本文没有任何结果源于该分析，在运行之前，确定性检查的任何优势都无法归因于检查本身，而只能归因于其对已批准要求的访问权限或针对特定故障的规则。

paragraphs.en: Our proposal sits in a crowded design space. EviBound combines a pre-execution approval gate with post-execution artifact verification and optional metric checks [ 1 ] ; it verifies a task, and a completed task can sit inside an inadmissible study, but ex-ante gating is not new. End-to-end workflow benchmarks show that partial scores and completion language are unreliable proxies for required scientific deliverables [ 11 ] ; specification-gaming benchmarks show modular ML agents improving reported metrics while violating scientific intent [ 12 ] —this is the closest existing evidence for the hypothesis in §2 and should inform baselines and threat models, not only motivation. Claim-aware observability binds claims to evidence explicitly [ 13 ] ; ClaimReceipt is the closest published comparison, checking evidence sufficiency and coverage for the claims an agent evaluation asserts [ 14 ] . That proximity makes a three-way distinction worth stating, because the three are routinely conflated: raising an objection is producing a reviewable finding that a claim may be unsupported; issuing a verdict is deciding that it is; enforcement is refusing to release it. ClaimReceipt and output-only judges operate at the first two levels over a submitted package. What is added here is the third, together with the reference the first two lack: a prospectively approved expected-unit denominator and claim ceiling that make a coverage question answerable at all, plus the authority to block promotion rather than annotate it. We do not claim ClaimReceipt lacks claim awareness, nor that objections are worth less than enforcement—an objection a human acts on may be worth more than an automatic block. tamper-evident flight recorders protect record integrity, which is distinct from truthful observation [ 15 ] ; Agentic Configuration Management supplies typed versioned configuration items, immutable baselines, lifecycle assurance and dependency propagation [ 16 ] . We do not claim these lack claim awareness or governance. Agentic-science systems supply the mechanisms—persistent memory, interim-conditioned revision, automatic retry, autonomous writing—through which M1–M6 could arise without adversarial intent; tool protocols widen the action surface [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的提案处于一个竞争激烈的设计空间中。 EviBound 将执行前的审批关卡与执行后的成果验证及可选的指标检查相结合 [ 1 ]；它会对任务进行验证，而一个已完成的任务可能存在于一个不可接受的研究中，但事前把关并非新事物。 端到端工作流基准测试表明，部分得分和完成语言并非可靠的可交付科学成果替代指标 [ 11]；规格操纵基准测试则显示，模块化 ML 智能体在提升报告指标的同时违反了科学意图 [ 12]——这是目前最接近 §2 中假设的证据，应据此设定基线和威胁模型，而不仅仅是作为动机。 声明感知型可观察性将声明与证据明确绑定 [ 13]；ClaimReceipt 是最接近的已发表对比方法，它能检查智能体评估所断言的声明的证据充分性和覆盖范围 [ 14]。 这种接近性使得有必要明确区分三种不同行为，因为它们通常被混为一谈：提出反对意见是生成一个可供审查的发现，表明某项声明可能缺乏支持；作出裁决是判定该声明确实如此；执行强制则是拒绝发布该声明。 ClaimReceipt 和仅输出结果的评判器在提交包上运行于前两个层级。 本文新增的是第三个层级，以及前两者所缺乏的参照：一个事先批准的预期单位分母和声明上限，这使得覆盖范围问题变得可回答；此外还包括阻止升级而非仅添加注释的权限。 我们不声称 ClaimReceipt 缺乏声明感知能力，也不认为反对意见的价值低于强制执行——人类采取行动的反对意见可能比自动阻断更有价值。防篡改飞行记录仪能保护记录完整性，这与真实观察是不同概念 [ 15]；智能体配置管理则提供带类型和版本的控制项、不可变的基线、生命周期保障和依赖关系传播 [ 16]。 我们不声称这些方法缺乏声明感知能力或治理机制。 智能体科学系统提供了必要的机制——持久化记忆、基于临时条件的修订、自动重试和自主写作——使得 M1–M6 无需对抗性意图即可出现；工具协议则扩展了可执行动作的范围 [ 17]。

paragraphs.en: This paper is one of three companion preprints that share a research-contract framework and a prototype multi-domain research platform. Its distinct contribution is the information required to verify contract-relative compliance, including the information-boundary diagnostic on a self-authored development corpus. A companion position paper argues for study-level scientific authorization and claim promotion [ 30 ] ; another treats scarce verification capacity as a triage allocation problem [ 31 ] . The eight-pair diagnostic and selected historical audits are shared records, not independent replications across the three papers.
paragraphs.zh: 本文是三篇配套预印本之一，这些预印本共享一个研究合同框架和一个原型多域研究平台。 其独特的贡献在于提供了验证合同相对合规性所需的信息，包括对自主撰写的开发语料库进行的信息边界诊断。 一篇配套立场论文主张在研究层面实施科学授权和主张推广 [ 30 ]；另一篇则将稀缺的验证能力视为一个优先分配问题 [ 31]。 八对诊断和选定的历史审计是共享记录，而非三篇论文之间相互独立的重复研究。

paragraphs.en: “Who verifies the agents?” has an uncomfortable answer for research agents: often, a judge reading prose the agent wrote. A stronger output-only model cannot resolve facts that are genuinely missing from the package. On our development corpus, the two absence faults—those for which an approved requirement would specify what should have been present—were the ones metadata-filtered judges almost never flagged; that pattern is consistent with missing requirements, while a full-information equal-task comparator remains untested. Conceptually, identical visible packages can still correspond to different approved obligations; the small diagnostic does not by itself establish that causal claim for every fault class. A study-level contract exposes four relations that cannot be established from the output alone: whether the executed study is the authorized one along a versioned chain, whether the denominator is intact, whether the claim is inside its authorized scope, and whether a human with real authority signed off on the checked boundaries. None of this determines whether the science is correct. It determines what a verifier can decide at all, and it makes the closed-loop question—does enforcement improve useful compliant completion under optimization—well posed enough to test.
paragraphs.zh: “谁对智能体进行验证？”这个问题对于研究智能体来说，答案令人不安：通常是由一位法官阅读该智能体所写的文本。 一个仅能生成输出的更强模型，无法解决那些在所提供的材料中确实缺失的事实。 在我们的开发语料库中，两种缺失故障——即本应存在但未被包含的情况，而批准的要求本应明确说明这些内容——是元数据筛选后的法官几乎从未指出的问题；这一模式与要求缺失相符，而一个基于完整信息的同等任务比较模型尚未经过测试。 从概念上讲，外观完全相同的材料包仍可能对应不同的批准义务；仅凭这一小项诊断本身，无法证明该因果关系适用于所有故障类别。 一项研究级别的合同揭示了四种仅凭输出无法确定的关系：所执行的研究是否属于版本链中授权的那一个、分母是否完整、主张是否在授权范围内，以及是否有真正拥有权限的人类对已检查的边界进行了批准。 以上任何一点都无法确定该研究本身是否正确。 它决定了验证者究竟能够判断什么，并使“执行是否能在优化条件下提升有效且合规的完成度”这一闭环问题变得足够明确，从而可以加以测试。
